title: 🌐 How does your browser find a website? #domain #networking #systemdesign #https #dns
description:
In this short, you'll learn how the Domain Name System (DNS) translates a domain name like example.com into an IP address by communicating with:
✅ Recursive Resolver
✅ Root Server
✅ TLD Server
✅ Authoritative Name Server
✅ DNS Cache (TTL)
This is a must-know concept for System Design, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, DevOps, and Software Engineering interviews.
